incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: hosted-api-p95-blowup - priority P1 - paging Rohit (oncall) @here
Rohit (oncall): seeing huge queue growth in us-east-hosted. p95 -> 2.3s, p99 -> 12.1s, request backlog ~42k. autoscaler not creating new GPU nodes, lots of evictions.
Jen (sre): logs show provisioner errors: \`RateLimitExceeded: quota create instances\` and leader-heartbeat timeouts. stack: provisioner -> autoscaler -> shard-leader.
Alex (eng-provision): on it, hitting cloud quota on our spot pool. I can temporarily bump max_pools and flip to on-demand for burst. prepping a change.
Rohit (oncall): quick customer impact check - Lena?
Lena (cs): we've 3 customers reporting 503s, one on a paid SLA. Customer A experiencing timeouts in inference, intermittent 502/504s. escalation ready if needed.
Sam (eng-runtime): KV cache pressure noted, many short lived contexts causing cache churn. Also seeing eviction deadlock where requests block waiting for slots. Suggest enabling fallback routing to smaller-quantized model variant.
Rohit (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback route -> quantized-v2 for non-SLA customers 2) Alex flip to on-demand + temporary pool 3) increase autoscaler max_nodes from 80 -> 120 4) apply rate-limit to anonymous keys to shed load.
Alex (eng-provision): applying on-demand pool now (cmd):
```bash
cloudctl pool update --region us-east --pool hosted-spots --fallback on-demand --max 120
```
DeployBot: Deploy started: pool update (id: d7f3)
Jen (sre): manual autoscaler override engaged (leader force-create). watching creation logs.
(2m) Sam (eng-runtime): enabling fallback routing rule: \`route.health=degraded -> model=quantized-v2\`
Rohit (oncall): rate-limit rule for anonymous keys: 10r/s applied.
Lena (cs): Customer A notified; created incident ticket INC-1829 with mitigation note.
(4m) DeployBot: pool update succeeded, 32 on-demand nodes up.
Alex (eng-provision): autoscaler now seeing capacity, creating pods.
Sam (eng-runtime): backlog dropping: 42k -> 9.2k and p95 -> 480ms. p99 -> 1.8s.
Rohit (oncall): great. still keep fallback and rate-limits for 30m. open action items: quota request to cloud team, postmortem on autoscaler failure mode, improve heartbeat visibility.
Jen (sre): tagging next shift for handoff @oncall-next.
Rohit (oncall): handing off to Jen for overnight monitoring. last_resp: 1732127905
